verdict.rationale: Sill's privacy page says there is no account and no server, and that screen and keystroke data travel only between your own devices. It names one outbound contact, a daily update check to api.github.com, and documents a Settings › General toggle ('Check for updates automatically') to turn it off, so the user can stop all phone-home activity. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no analytics or crash reporting is collected, and independent or hands-on network verification of the no-telemetry claim.
